snippet.title: BattleGroupVR2 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now!
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385960/BattleGroupVR2/
META QUEST: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/battlegroupvr2/9386827918099701/

BattleGroupVR2 is a virtual reality real-time space strategy where you explore the galaxy and lead a fleet of powerful warships from the bridge of your flagship. Explore, mine, trade, hunt. Grow your fleet, upgrade your ships, train your captains, and battle the enemy from the captain's chair.

Join the discord! https://discord.gg/f86JjH9Nqe
